description: This file defines an abstract base class 'PlacementFilterAttribute' used for creating placement filter marker attributes within the Orleans framework. It includes a property for the placement filter strategy and a method to populate grain properties based on that strategy.

classes.name: PlacementFilterAttribute
classes.description: An abstract base class for all placement filter marker attributes in Orleans, providing a strategy property and a method to populate grain properties.

methods.name: PlacementFilterAttribute
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the placement filter strategy, throwing an exception if null.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to populate grain properties using the placement filter strategy.
